title: Plugin source manifest (plugins/<name>/plugin.yaml)
description: Authoring source of truth for a plugin. Platform manifests (plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .cursor-plugin/plugin.json, gemini-extension.json, mcp.json, .mcp.json) are generated from this file.

name.description: Permanent identifier. Must equal the folder name. Never rename after release.

long_description.description: Optional Markdown paragraph inserted into the generated plugin README.

skill_order.description: Optional display order of the plugin's skills in the README, catalog, and plugin README. Skills not listed follow alphabetically.

mcp_servers.description: IDs from mcp/servers.yaml. Only servers with bundle_policy 'bundle' may be listed.

microsoft_skills.description: Eligibility for contribution to github.com/microsoft/skills. Only 'candidate' or later may be exported.
